paper_recipe_vs_adaptation: Same pretrained YOLOv8n baseline and prior full60 recipe, using author-normal TAD clip labels as empty bbox labels only for sampled reviewed sources. This is a dataset expansion experiment, not a reproduction of TAD paper metrics.
limitations: Old positive validation has already been used. New negative validation has four provisional scene groups; held-out negative reserve is not a full new positive/negative benchmark. No guarantee of better generalization; camera independence remains unproven.
hardware_decision: workers=0 to reduce RAM use after DataLoader worker OpenCV allocation failure; batch 8, image 640, SGD and LR unchanged. This changes loading process only, but stochastic reproducibility across worker counts is not guaranteed.
experiment_purpose: Hold SGD lr0 .001, batch8, img640, workers0, seed and 60 epochs/patience0 as in prior full60 run; expand only source-reviewed negative data. Evaluate enlarged validation only; do not use old consumed test or sealed negative reserve for selection.
